Subject: DPA redlines attached — subprocessor list + transfer mechanism

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are our redlines to Redwood's standard DPA (Redlines_DPA_FinTrust_v3.pdf). Two items are blocking legal sign-off on our side:

- We need named subprocessors and the ability to object to new subprocessors before they are onboarded (we included a proposed 30-day notice/objection clause).
- We need clarity on cross-border transfers: the customer requires either in-region hosting or assurance that transfers rely on SCCs plus technical controls (KMS with customer-managed keys).

We also attached our current subprocessors list for reference (Subprocessors_list_20260412.csv). We're trying to get this wrapped up for our pilot kickoff on Apr 20 — are those timelines feasible?

Please confirm receipt and next steps.

Best,

Cc:

Subject: Re: DPA redlines attached — legal assessment + exception path

Priya / Karthik — reviewed FinTrust's redlines. Summary of legal position:

1) Subprocessors: we can provide a named list today but cannot agree to a unilateral customer "object and veto" right. Proposed compromise: 30-day notice + documented objection window + temporary mitigation (restricting processing of the customer's data to existing approved subprocessors while complaint is reviewed).

2) Transfers: FinTrust is asking for in-region hosting OR SCCs + customer-managed KMS. We do not currently offer EU-only hosting for their account on our hosted tier without Dedicated/Private.

Escalation/exception ask: To keep the pilot timeline, we can propose SCCs + additional contractual commitments (encryption-at-rest with KMS controls, enhanced logging, Data Access Audit) but this requires an exec-level risk exception because it is a deviation from our standard requirement that higher-risk customers use Dedicated or Private for guaranteed region residency.

I attached a Security Exception Form with the controls we'd commit to if exec approves. If we escalate, we'll need a short one-page risk memo for VP Legal/Head of Security outlining residual risk and proposed mitigations.

Naomi
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Security_Exception_Form_20260413.pdf (pdf)

From: Lina Cruz <lina.cruz@fintrust.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines attached — timeline pressure

Thanks for the quick review. Respectfully — the pilot start date is firm: Apr 20. Our board has committed resources and delaying will materially impact our product roadmap.

If Redwood cannot sign an in-region guarantee we will consider the SCCs + technical controls route, but we need written confirmation that:
- The agreed controls will be in place prior to pilot start.
- The DocuSign envelope can be executed by Apr 18 EOD.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/0F3A9B8C

Would NL (Naomi) be able to prepare the one-page risk memo today if we commit to the SCC+KMS path? That memo will be used internally to get our infra sign-off.

Best,
Lina

Team / Lina — one possible pragmatic option: offer FinTrust a 30-day limited pilot under an interim Technical Controls Addendum (TCA) that commits us to:
- Enforce SCCs for transfers,
- Enable CMEK (customer-managed encryption keys) scoped to FinTrust for the pilot where feasible,
- Provide daily access logs and a named contact for rapid incident response.

If we combine the TCA + a short risk memo from Naomi, the pilot could start while we evaluate Dedicated/Private onboarding if customer scales. Commercially, we can offer a one-time credit if they move to Dedicated within 90 days.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Note: Karthik's availability for hand-off to FinTrust's infra team is limited Fri morning.

I've drafted an Exec Exception Request and attached it (Exec_Exception_Request_20260414.docx). Proposed asks for exec:
- Approve a limited risk exception for the pilot to allow hosted execution with SCCs + implemented CMEK for the FinTrust account only.
- Approve comms: a one-page risk memo that Naomi will sign off for FinTrust's infra team.
- Commercial concession: 30% credit on first month if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days (commercial to confirm).

We need a decision by EOD Fri 16 Apr to meet FinTrust's DocuSign deadline Apr 18.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FT-2026-042), DocuSign (https://docusign.com/envelope/0F3A9B8C).
